scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: Neel selects several building pictures in a fictional classroom feed. The next set contains even more buildings. Tara notices that the feed is responding to earlier choices, then giving Neel more opportunities to repeat the same kind of choice.
scenes.speech: Neel selects several building pictures in a fictional classroom feed. The next set contains even more buildings. Tara notices that the feed is responding to earlier choices, then giving Neel more opportunities to repeat the same kind of choice.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: This feedback loop can make a feed narrower without showing what matters most. A predicted interest is not a fact check, a judgement of quality or an instruction to keep watching. The visible classroom rule counts selected topics; real systems can use many other signals.
scenes.speech: This feedback loop can make a feed narrower without showing what matters most. A predicted interest is not a fact check, a judgement of quality or an instruction to keep watching. The visible classroom rule counts selected topics; real systems can use many other signals.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The team compares a repeated feed with a deliberately varied reading list. Neel chooses a different checked source and sets a stopping point for the activity. Learners can inspect the reason for a suggestion and make their own decision rather than treating the next item as a command.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The fictional feed counted earlier building selections and used them to choose the next item. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: The fictional feed counted earlier building selections and used them to choose the next item. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: What does another building suggestion establish?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: It reflects the feed’s prediction of interest. It does not establish that the item is true, best or worth more time than your intended task.
scenes.speech: It reflects the feed’s prediction of interest. It does not establish that the item is true, best or worth more time than your intended task.
scenes.dialogue: Explain why a suggestion is not proof of truth or importance.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate signals from choices, then a narrowing loop, then deliberate choices. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
scenes.speech: Investigate signals from choices, then a narrowing loop, then deliberate choices. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
scenes.dialogue: How can a feed become narrower without learning everything about a person?
